source_text: The mosquitoes used in this survey were collected outside but adjacent to the Obuasi malaria vector control area in July 2010.
Tarkwa/Damang: (5°18'N, 1°59'32"W) Two new mines in this area operated by AngloGold/Ashanti and Randgold Resources were sampled in May 2007 and March 2009.
Ahafo: (7°1'33"N, 2°20'27"W), a Newmont Mines operation, was sampled in December 2006 and June 2008.
Akyem: (6°20'24"N, 1°0'28"W) also operated by Newmont Mines, was sampled in June 2006.
Only five specimens of An. gambiae M form were available (from Tarkwa) for kdr analysis
The single M/S hybrid that survived exposure to deltamethrin was homozygous RR.
